This notice should be read with Part 9 of the Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) (Minimum Requirements for Seafarers etc.) Regulations 2014 (“the MLC Minimum Requirements Regulations”) and MGN 482(M) amendment 1. This notice replaces MSN 1841 amendment 1.

Notice to

shipowners

ship operators and ship managers

employers of seafarers

masters

officers

seafarers

On sea-going ships ordinarily engaged in commercial operations
